title: Relocation inventory of place-specific assets
desc: Write harness/design/RELOCATE_INVENTORY.md per templates/RELOCATE_PHASE.md section 1: every asset, data row and code path that carries the old place, with replace, reuse or remove and the replacement id or procedural plan. Grep source, data and the asset manifest for place names; take shots of every area with shoot.mjs.
accept: RELOCATE_INVENTORY.md lists every row with a decision
every replace row has a placeholder plan
the shots it used are listed

title: Asset request batches for the new place
desc: Register the inventory's replace rows as requests in batches R1 to R8 (templates/RELOCATE_PHASE.md section 3), with prompts from the signed style bible and CITY_BRIEF.md.
accept: assets.mjs pending prints nothing for the new ids
every request has a batch and a priority

title: Procedural road kit for the new place
desc: Road surfaces, lane paint, kerbs, shoulders and patches per CITY_BRIEF 'Road types', procedural first, swapping to delivered textures by id.
accept: lookproof views road_* within look_rules of the re-approved reference or shown to the owner
perf scenario drive_top_speed under budget

title: Procedural building massing and facades
desc: Footprint and height rules, facade kit and trim per CITY_BRIEF 'Districts' and 'Materials', instanced, with LODs.
accept: draw calls at the busiest view under budget
no pop-in visible in the drive frame sequence at top speed

title: Signage in the new script
desc: The signage system draws road and shop signs with the brief's scripts and word list.
accept: shots of each district show signs in the right script with no missing glyphs
the word list is the owner-checked one

title: Traffic vehicle kit for the new place
desc: A parametric, instanced vehicle kit for the brief's traffic mix and behaviour (honking, lane habits).
accept: traffic share in a 60 s drive matches the brief within 10 points
frame time while driving stays under budget

title: Street life, sky, light and ambience for the new place
desc: People, vendors and animals as instanced placeholders; sky, sun and haze per time of day; ambience beds per district.
accept: lookproof views for each time of day pass the rubric
audio scenario shows each district's bed playing

title: Landmarks
desc: The brief's landmarks at the chosen fidelity (hero model, kitbash or skyline silhouette).
accept: each landmark is visible from its planned spots on the route
no landmark breaks the draw call budget

title: Remove the old place
desc: Delete or retire every remove row and confirm no old-place asset is visible anywhere.
accept: shots of every district from the play camera show no old-place asset
grep for the old place name returns only legacy comments
verify --all green
